title: Opening: recording details and how Anthony became 'Bill'
summary: Recording date and address are stated and the people present named. Phillips says he got the name Bill when he joined a band in 1926.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: We're recording Mr. Phillips. Anthony Phillips.
Anthony Phillips. Did they call you Bill? Bill Phillips, yeah. Bill Phillips.

Bill Phillips. I'll mention the address is 1750 New Orleans. New Orleans Street and the date is May the 24th, 1961. In addition to Mr. Phillips, and this is Bill Russell, there's Ralph Collins and Harold Dagell. Okay, could you give your full name? Your given name then is Anthony. Anthony Phillips. How did you get the Bill name?

I tell you, when I was back in 1900, it must have been 1926, I joined the Ellsons and they called me Bill. Bill and he used that name, Bill and he thought Bill Phillips and that's the way it stood ever since then.
